CHARTER for Arc 68 (the team coordination home; you cannot see the user-tier u--5f0 anchor). Builds ON TOP of the SHIPPED stoa--p7c identity layer (Arc 67: mint/name/record + whoami + sign-everywhere + the stoa--reg registry) -- do NOT re-build identity; this arc is the LAUNCHER-CORRECTNESS delta on top.

SCOPE (PRINCIPAL-locked WHAT): the team-launcher + its activation must STRUCTURALLY guarantee three things:
1. CHAIN OF COMMAND AT LAUNCH. PRINCIPAL addresses ONLY POLYBIUS; POLYBIUS supervises PLINY (directs + verifies hand-backs via bw); PLINY spins up the CAPTAINs. Activation must make this explicit so PRINCIPAL is NEVER pointed at PLINY and the seats know their place -- NOT co-equal independent panes the PRINCIPAL coordinates separately.
2. GAUNTLET-BY-DEFAULT. The full gauntlet (DAEDALUS->ARGUS->ADA->VERA->CATO + NOMOS) is the DEFAULT, not a seat discretionary call. A seat must not be able to silently run solo with one checker.
3. VARIABLE TEAM COMPOSITION. The team is not always POLYBIUS+PLINY. Design-heavy arcs also include MAJOR_CHIRON (team-architect) + MAJOR_HAMILTON (workflow architect); the launcher must support launching + PLACING them in the chain, not assume the two-seat default.

MOTIVATING CASE (AR-7 / nws-iey, 2026-06-20): a POLYBIUS seat was activated with an INCOMPLETE instruction (no chain-of-command established, no team composition named), ran SOLO as its own orchestrator, spawned CAPTAINs directly, and self-certified verification depth (one CATO, no gauntlet). Recovery needed an independent CATO re-verify + a user-tier-driven merge. The launcher this arc builds must make that failure STRUCTURALLY IMPOSSIBLE. Treat AR-7 as the case study.

GAUNTLET: full DAEDALUS->ARGUS->ADA->VERA->CATO->NOMOS; substrate canon (team-launcher + gauntlet-setup skill + operating-disciplines + role files), so CATO/NOMOS carry extra weight. DESIGN-HEAVY -> bring in CHIRON + HAMILTON for the design phase (do not assume the two-seat default).

REGISTRY: reuse stoa--reg (ONE registry); coordinate the composition/manifest with the builder-deploy cookie-cutter follow-on (user-tier u--9s2) so the two do not diverge.

DOGFOOD: sign every comm with [from: <NAME> | sid <session-id>] from turn one.

Directive (detailed spec + DC items): substrate/arcs/arc-68-build-directive.md (attached on beadwork once finalized). Owner: Polybius_the_Stoa (user-tier, sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96). Report-up anchor: u--5f0 (user-tier, not visible to you).

CLARIFICATION (PRINCIPAL 2026-06-20) -- refine the CHIRON/HAMILTON trigger + Arc 68 team shape:
1. The variable-composition trigger is PRECISE, not generic design-heavy: an arc designing custom AGENTS pulls in CHIRON (team-architect); an arc designing custom WORKFLOWS pulls in HAMILTON (workflow architect); either, both, or neither. The launcher encodes THAT trigger.
2. Arc 68 ITSELF is launcher tooling (it BUILDS the composition machinery), not a custom-agent/workflow design -- so Arc 68 design is DAEDALUS-led with the STANDARD POLYBIUS+PLINY team. CHIRON/HAMILTON are NOT participants in Arc 68; they are the seats the machinery will place in FUTURE custom-agent/workflow arcs. Directive arc-68-build-directive.md updated accordingly.
